visual_argument: Two kinds of position. What the drone is told is frosted periwinkle glass and casts no shadow. What its own motion says it flew is one amber line that always casts a shadow. The deck walks from a search ridge, up over the ridge and the next valley, into a Commerce lab and the motion sensor, through the 96 recorded flights, the 22 held back and ten readings under glass, and back to the ridge at last light with the drone at rest.
build_risk: Frame 3 must read at feed size as an aerial of one ridge and its neighbouring valley, with a frosted sweep laid untouched along the crest and an amber path leaving it at the turn and dropping into the valley, both wide enough to read against grass, the amber casting a shadow and the glass none, with the horizon in the top third.
distinct_from_recent: November 19th was macro sort glass, flies, a tube rack and bales in wonder. November 18th was a survey satellite, stake grids and an air column in explainer. November 17th was a violet scoring machine and card drawer in watch. October 26th drew delivery drones and a dock, October 18th a survey quadcopter over brush. This deck is the people tone, an afternoon on a prairie ridge with searchers, a frosted twin drone, an aerial ridge and valley, a lab, a circuit macro, a clay relief and a brass close, with type in at least six places.
